objective: Measure how Match Grain reference native resolution, when resized to the output frame before Gaussian high-pass extraction, changes the transferred grain residual amplitude and spatial correlation length.

scope.effect: ArtifactMatchGrainEffect reference preparation, GaussianBlur high-frequency residual, luma-only response on a neutral source; all controls fixed except reference native/output resolution and grainSize.
scope.method: Offline Float32 OpenCV source-equation model. Generate one deterministic 1024x512 neutral reference with seeded broadband texture; derive 256x128 and 512x256 native variants with INTER_AREA. Prepare each reference at 512x256 and 1024x512 using the source INTER_LINEAR resize, then subtract GaussianBlur at grainSize 1.15 and 3.0. Set temporalJitter=0 to isolate spatial transfer.
excluded: named-input service routing or import descriptors

comparison.baseline: The same neutral .5 RGB target with Match Grain mix=0; input-output residual identity reference.
candidates: grainSize 1.15 / 3.0; all other Match Grain controls fixed to defaults except temporalJitter=0
comparison.ground_truth: None. The synthetic reference is a deterministic broadband texture; it is not an approved grain look or physical stock scan.
comparison.acceptance: Descriptive only. Verify resize rule, exact source markers, zero residual when reference is constant/mix=0, alpha identity, and deterministic generation. Measure residual stddev and correlation length; do not infer runtime, image quality, or user-perceived grain strength.

materials.fixture: Synthetic neutral Float32 1024x512 reference composed of fixed gray base plus deterministic broadband scalar texture; native-resolution variants generated by INTER_AREA. Target images are neutral .5 RGB, opaque alpha.
materials.identity: Record hashes of plan, source, script, native reference fixtures, and outputs. Save exact fixture dimensions, seed and equations.

regions.center: central crop excluding 16px border for correlation profiles

conditions.numeric_domain: Float32 direct numeric [0,1], no transfer conversion. All reference channels equal; alpha is opaque. Aux resize is OpenCV INTER_LINEAR per inspected prepareAuxiliaryImage; reference downsample variants are generated with INTER_AREA and are explicitly synthetic.
conditions.equation: prepared = reference if same size else cv::resize(INTER_LINEAR); residual[channel] = prepared[channel] - GaussianBlur(prepared[channel], sigma=max(.1, grainSize)); for neutral reference and source, grain = residualLuma * lumaAmount * amount * response; source output adds grain*mix; source alpha copied.
conditions.regions_and_rois: Whole-frame residual distribution and central 16px-inset crop autocorrelation in x/y; profile length uses first lag <= 1/e of lag-zero-normalized autocorrelation.
metrics: lag 1 correlation and first 1/e correlation length (pixels and normalized to output size)
residual energy retained relative to prepared reference high-frequency energy
inter-output-size field correlation after normalized resampling, labeled exploratory
conditions.display: Contact sheet contains native reference previews and amplified Match Grain residuals; raw Float32 arrays and metrics are authoritative.

effect_correctness.method: Verify prepareAuxiliaryImage same-size clone / INTER_LINEAR resize, Gaussian residual subtraction, neutral luma/chroma response, zero-mix identity and alpha copy.
effect_correctness.acceptance_criteria: Exact equation-model invariants; no compiled parity claim.

image_quality_and_detail.method: Inspect reference and residual contact sheets at native and enlarged view; report statistical spatial scale.
image_quality_and_detail.acceptance_criteria: No aesthetic acceptance or physical-grain claim.

color_and_alpha.method: Measure neutral RGB response, range, alpha identity.
color_and_alpha.unverified: Colored reference, real alpha association, transfer function and import color metadata.

temporal_stability.reason: temporalJitter is zero and only one frame is studied.

render_paths_and_resolution.unverified: Compiled C++ path, reference import/resample behavior in actual assets, preview/final and GPU routes.

evaluation.decision: No visual-quality acceptance or product parameter recommendation.

execution.backend: Python NumPy/OpenCV/Pillow offline model; no UI, app, build or test execution.
execution.threshold_policy: No perceptual threshold; all values descriptive.
execution.reproducibility: Fixed texture seed, native/target dimensions, OpenCV resize and Gaussian equations, hashes.
